newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ansaldo signals group changes.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ansaldo signals group changes.

text.p: Italy's Ansaldo Trasporti SpA said it was merging its railway signalling activities into a new company, Ansaldo Signal NV.
Ansaldo Signal, a Netherlands holding company, will be quoted on Nasdaq under the symbol ASIGF.O, replacing Union Switch & Signal Corp which will merge into the Ansaldo Signal umbrella company.
Ansaldo, part of the Finmeccanica group, said in a statement the new company will have a turnover of 680 billion lire. It will be the second largest signalling company in the world.
Ansaldo Trasporti will hold 72 percent of the capital, France's Compagnie de Signaux will have 9.8 percent and the rest will be in public hands.

Other Ansaldo Trasporti signalling operations coming under the new umbrella company include CSEE Transport SA of France, Italy's Ansaldo Segnalamento Ferroviario, Sweden's AT Signal Systems AB and Ansaldo Trasporti Signalling (Ireland) Ltd.
